normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in WaterColor's Lake District- Short 5-minute bike ride to the beach, shops, and restaurants- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $25 per day**- Professionally decorated - Gourmet kitchen- Washer/dryer- Outdoor kitchen area with ice maker, refrigerator, double burner grill, and sink with hot and cold water - Fire pit- 2 dedicated parking spots with additional parking found throughout community- 4 adult bikes- 4-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters, are laundered upon every checkout**Newly added sleeping Queen area-pictures coming soon.**Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, a third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Spend your next beach getaway at "Nostra Vita," a luxurious 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath retreat located in the Lake District of WaterColor with close proximity to the Frog Pool and Sandhill Park. Featuring 2 primary suites and 2 additional guest bedrooms, 335 Needlerush Drive can sleep up to 10 guests and is an ideal home for any family looking for an unforgettable beach stay! You'll feel right at home from the moment you arrive, with the home's sprawling front porch to greet you. Make your way inside for inviting, posh interiors and beautiful craftsmanship displayed in every room. This expansive, open home has space for every member of your group to spread out but also brings the family together in the open-concept kitchen, dining room, and living room, which boast incredible natural light and upscale finishes. French doors lead out to the back patio and beautiful backyard that includes a fire pit, lounge space, as well as a private, heated pool! Work up an appetite swimming and then enjoy the outdoor kitchen's recent addition, including a commercial ice maker, refrigerator, and double burner grill. "Nostra Vita" is moments away from the many great amenities WaterColor has to offer, including The Boathouse, various biking and walking paths, parks, and Western Lake. Hop on the provided bikes, and you're just a short 5-minute ride to the beach or to the shops and restaurants of WaterColor and neighboring Seaside! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10)FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom With Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds (4), Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom With Shower and TubWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
